question.explanation: Drake's projects range from early independent mixtapes to solo studio albums and collaborations. Compilation album Care Package and the playlist More Life also count; EPs do not.
question.criteria: Any released Drake solo or collaborative album or mixtape counts, including compilation albums and More Life, his playlist project. EPs, singles, and albums on which he is only a guest do not count.

provenance.brief: Name a Drake album or mixtape.

quotes.Thank Me Later: Drake's debut album, Thank Me Later (2010), debuted atop the Billboard 200
quotes.Take Care: In November 2010, Drake revealed the title of his next studio album would be Take Care.
quotes.Nothing Was the Same: Drake announced his third album, Nothing Was the Same, and released its first single.
quotes.Views: The album was originally titled Views from the 6, but was later shortened to Views.
quotes.Scorpion: In 2018, Drake released his fifth studio album, Scorpion,
quotes.Certified Lover Boy: Certified Lover Boy was released on September 3, 2021, becoming Drake's tenth number-one album on the Billboard 200;
quotes.Honestly, Nevermind: On June 16, Drake announced his seventh album, Honestly, Nevermind, which released a day later;
quotes.For All the Dogs: Drake announced his eighth studio album, titled For All the Dogs.
